requirement: MCP exposes fixed contract tools and refuses hidden operation dispatch

oracle.invariant: Every public contract operation except provisioning-only derive has a separate description, input schema and correct read/write annotations. Every tool dispatches only its fixed contract operation. Operation overrides and the removed dispatcher return JSON-RPC -32602 without a REST call. Apply requires changes and preserves If-Match and Idempotency-Key.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: MCP exposes every callable contract operation separately and omits the dispatcher and provisioning
MCP contract tools dispatch only their fixed operation and reject operation injection before REST
MCP contract apply requires changes and preserves declared revision and retry headers
a domain directory imports only lib/ and db/, never another domain
